text:
Sam (mktg): Quick plan — 48h precision burst for Nov 14 webinar. Focus: search + short retarget window + creative rotation. Need budget and auto-swap rules by noon. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ivy (growth): Budget? target CPL? regions?

Sam (mktg): $950/day US + UK for 2 days = $1,900. CPL target <$50, aim 60 regs in 48h. Regions US/UK. Frontload 20% first 2 hours.

Noah (creative): I'll deliver 3 hero variants: Benefit, Proof, Urgency. Recommend benefit for search and proof for retarget.

Tess (analytics): LP split suggestion: 70% single-step, 30% two-step. Add hidden reg_uuid. GA4 events: webinar_reg, webinar_attend_30. Alert CPA>60 -> notify @Ivy.

Rex (ops): Routing: regs -> SFDC campaign "Nov14_PrecisionBurst"; attended >=30% -> HubSpot SDR queue. Need Zap creds after QA.

Ivy (growth): Search structure: 3 ad groups (inference, infra-performance, cost). Start with exact + phrase, no broad. Bidding: max conversions tCPA $45. Enable accelerated delivery first 2 hours.

Sam (mktg): Auto-swap rules I propose: if CTR <0.45% after 4h -> swap to Urgency creative; if CTR >1.1% but conv rate <7% -> force LP-two-step; if CPA >$70 after 12h -> cut search spend by 40% and boost retarget bids +20%. Agree?

Noah (creative): Agreed. Uploading assets to drive now: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/nov14_precision_assets (placeholder). Also making last-hour creative variants.

Tess (analytics): UTM template: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=nov14_precision&utm_content={creative}&utm_term={keyword}. I'll add an hourly CPA tile and session stitch via reg_uuid.

Ivy (growth): Audience layering: for search, add in-market for "cloud infra" to tighten intent. For retarget, use 7-day LP viewers + 14-day video engaged.

Rex (ops): Campaign skeleton (ads): Search (3 ad groups), Retarget (7-day + 14-day), Creative rotation: rotate evenly first 6 hours then optimize for conversions. Negative keywords: internship, course, tutorial.

Sam (mktg): Can we set a quick health check at T+6h: if CTR <0.5% OR bounce rate >65% -> swap creative and lower bids on low-performing keywords?

Tess (analytics): I'll implement T+6h watch rule and set Slack alert. Also configure conversion window: registrations 7d, attendance 30d.

Noah (creative): Quick copy seeds:
H1-1: Ship production LLM features faster — live demo Nov 14
H1-2: Reduce inference cost & latency — 20-min demo
Desc: Live demo + checklist. Seats limited.

Ivy (growth): Pacing: frontload 20% hour1, 15% hour2, then even. Cap spend so no more than 40% of daily in first 6 hours.

ads-bot: Draft campaign created: campaign_id=cmp_nov14_2026, draft_url=https://ads.internal/cmp_nov14_2026

Rex (ops): QA checklist: assets uploaded, UTMs, reg_uuid, GA tag, Zap staging test, negative keywords applied. I'll run the Zap test after creative upload.

Sam (mktg): Who owns final go? @Rex. Timeline: assets by 2pm, draft in UI by 4pm, QA + go-live tomorrow 9am PT.

Noah (creative): Uploaded assets and last-hour gifs.

Tess (analytics): Pixel & GA test passed in staging. Session stitch OK. I'll run one end-to-end test after draft.

Ivy (growth): I'll monitor first 2 hours and post hourly snapshots. If CPA drifts >20% after 8 hours, apply Tess's tightening rules.

Rex (ops): Zap staging passed. Requesting prod key after final review. Moving draft -> pending_review.

ads-bot: campaign cmp_nov14_2026 moved to pending_review by Rex

Sam (mktg): Thanks team. Final note: add a small retarget variant offering "webinar + checklist PDF" for visitors who didn't convert first touch. Noah please include one creative for that.

Noah (creative): Added checklist creative.

Sam (mktg): End thread — will post go-live + first-hour snapshot once live. :white_check_mark:
